films.desc_en: A seamless visual journey showcasing the striking transformation of a barren Skopje courtyard into a lush, thriving oasis over time.
films.music: slow ambient electronic, rhythmic ticking, building strings, 90 bpm

shots.kf: Wide angle shot of a barren, dry, dusty courtyard behind a traditional Macedonian stone house in Matka Canyon. The ground is cracked earth with sparse, brown weeds. Flat, overcast lighting casts soft, dull shadows. 24mm lens, eye-level composition. Earthy tones, photorealistic, highly detailed, cinematic.
shots.end_kf: Wide angle shot of the same courtyard behind a traditional Macedonian stone house, now a vibrant, manicured garden. Lush green grass, blossoming hydrangeas, and a small stone pathway. Golden hour sunlight streaming through the trees. 24mm lens, eye-level composition. Rich greens and warm yellows, photorealistic, cinematic.
shots.motion: The dry earth seamlessly morphs into lush grass and blooming flowers as the lighting shifts from overcast to warm golden hour. Slow push-in camera move.

shots.kf: Medium shot of an empty, cracked concrete patio area next to a bare brick wall. A single abandoned wooden planter sits in the corner. Harsh midday sun creates stark, unforgiving shadows. 35mm lens, symmetrical composition. Monotonous grey and beige palette, photorealistic, highly detailed and textured.
shots.end_kf: Medium shot of the same patio area, now covered in smooth wooden decking. A modern outdoor seating arrangement is surrounded by tall potted olive trees and creeping green ivy on the brick wall. Soft afternoon light. 35mm lens. Warm wood tones and vibrant greens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The cracked concrete dissolves into elegant wooden decking while green vines rapidly climb the brick wall. Very slow camera pan from left to right.

shots.kf: Close-up wide shot of a neglected corner of a dusty yard in Skopje, filled with dry gravel and a messy pile of old grey rocks. Dull, flat morning light washes out the scene. 50mm lens, low angle. Desaturated greys and browns, photorealistic, sharp focus.
shots.end_kf: Close-up wide shot of the same corner, now featuring a pristine, bubbling stone water fountain surrounded by vibrant purple lavender bushes. Bright, crisp morning sunlight catching the splashing water drops. 50mm lens, low angle. Vivid purples, cool greys, lush greens, photorealistic, highly detailed.
shots.motion: The pile of rocks magically shifts and forms into a fountain as water begins to flow, while lavender bushes sprout instantly. Slow upward camera tilt.

shots.kf: Wide shot looking up at a bare, unfinished wooden pergola frame against a pale, cloudy late afternoon sky. No plants, stark, lifeless, and weathered wood. 24mm lens, low angle looking directly up at the structure. Muted greys and pale blues, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
shots.end_kf: Wide shot of the same pergola frame, now heavily draped in lush, blooming purple wisteria vines. Elegant string lights hang from the wood, glowing warmly against a deep twilight blue sky. 24mm lens, low angle. Rich deep blues, warm golden lights, soft purples, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Wisteria vines quickly wrap around the wooden beams, and warm string lights fade in as the sky gracefully darkens to twilight. Completely static camera.

films.line_en: Your piece of peace in the world.
films.desc_en: An emotional, atmospheric exploration of a beautifully landscaped garden through changing seasons, highlighting the serenity of nature.
films.music: gentle acoustic guitar, soft piano chords, emotional, 75 bpm

shots.kf: Close-up shot of a single, vibrant green fern frond gently unrolling in a lush, dewy garden near Ohrid. Soft, diffused morning mist filters the sunlight into a gentle, ethereal glow. Macro lens, shallow depth of field, off-center composition. Deep, rich greens, photorealistic, incredibly detailed nature photography.
shots.motion: The delicate fern frond sways very gently in the cool morning breeze. The camera performs a slow, smooth macro pull-back to reveal more leaves.

shots.kf: Wide cinematic shot of a beautifully landscaped modern backyard garden overlooking Lake Ohrid. Tall ornamental grasses sway next to a pristine, curving stone pathway. Bright, warm summer afternoon sunlight bathes the scene. 35mm lens, rule of thirds composition. Golden yellows, vibrant greens, deep lake blues, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The tall ornamental grasses ripple softly as if brushed by a gentle summer wind. The camera glides slowly forward along the curving stone path.

shots.kf: Medium close-up of a graceful Japanese maple tree in a Skopje suburban garden, its intricate leaves turned a brilliant, fiery red. The late afternoon autumn sun creates a warm, glowing backlit halo effect around the foliage. 50mm lens, eye-level. Crimson, orange, and soft amber palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A few red autumn leaves tremble delicately in the crisp, cool air. A slow, smooth camera pan from right to left across the vibrant foliage.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a minimalist, zen-inspired Macedonian garden covered in a light, sparkling dusting of pristine winter snow. A perfectly pruned bonsai-style pine tree stands out as the main focal point. Cold, crisp morning light. 24mm lens, symmetrical composition. Cool icy blues, crisp whites, dark greens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Tiny, delicate snowflakes fall gently and continuously over the serene, snow-covered garden scene. The camera slowly cranes up, revealing more of the pristine ground.

shots.kf: Medium shot of two steaming ceramic mugs resting on a beautifully weathered wooden garden table. In the softly blurred background, colorful spring tulips bloom brightly in manicured flowerbeds. Warm golden hour light casts long, inviting shadows. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Earthy browns, vibrant pinks, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick, warm steam gently rises and swirls from the hot ceramic mugs into the cool air. The camera slowly pushes in towards the wooden table.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a contemporary landscaped garden at dusk. Soft, hidden warm LED lights beautifully illuminate small decorative shrubs and a gentle, cascading stone waterfall. The sky above is a deep, rich indigo twilight. 35mm lens, low angle composition. Indigo blues, warm golden glows, lush dark greens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Clear water flows smoothly and endlessly down the illuminated stone waterfall. The camera performs a very slow, stabilizing pan to the right across the yard.
